sections.title: Overwatch 2 X LE SSERAFIM
sections.description: Overwatch 2 x LE SSERAFIM are back with a new collab, bringing their energy, attitude, and bold aesthetic to the battlefield. With five brand-new Legendary skins featuring vibrant colors and standout details—like Ashe’s dynamite to light up the fight with RGB effects—this collection is a must-have for fans of both Overwatch 2 and LE SSERAFIM. Complete in-game challenges to earn free cosmetics, including the Legendary Fawksey James Junkrat skin.

sections.title: Overwatch 2 Classic - GOATS
sections.description: Step into Overwatch history with Overwatch Classic: GOATS, where teamwork, sustain, and strategy reign supreme. This iconic meta defined an entire era of competitive play, proving that three tanks, three supports, and perfectly timed abilities could be the ultimate formula for victory. Whether you remember GOATS from its prime or are experiencing it for the first time, now’s your chance to relive one of Overwatch’s most influential moments that rewrote the rules of team play. Overwatch 2 Classic: GOATS begins on March 25. Heroes added include Moira, Brigitte, and Wrecking Ball. Maps added include Blizzard World, Rialto, and Busan. Hero balance is adjusted to the September 2018 Hero Balance.

sections.title: New Mythic Weapon - Widowmaker's Dame Chance
sections.description: A gift from Talon's favorite financier, Dame Chance is a rifle of grace, refinement, and supreme lethality. Featuring a stunning crystalline core that reacts to your performance, evolving customization, exclusive animations, and a dynamic Mythic HUD, this is the ultimate sniper’s flex. If you live for those pixel-perfect headshots, it’s time to show the world what true precision looks like with the Mythic Dame Chance Widowmaker Weapon Skin.

sections.title: 6v6 Open Queue - Max 2 Tanks
sections.description: 6v6 Open Queue is back in Overwatch 2! From 3/18 to 4/20, experience the classic format with a modern upgrade, as Perks and a two-tank max bring new layers of strategy to every match. 6v6 Open Queue will temporarily replace 5v5 Open Queue in both ranked and unranked play, giving you a refreshed way to dominate. Whether you’re stacking tanks, coordinating big team plays, or flexing into any role, 6v6 Open Queue gives you the freedom to shape the fight your way. Available from March 18 to April 21—don’t miss experiencing Perks in 6v6! Due to an issue, this mode will only be available in Competitive Play until a future update. For Competitive play, wide queue is not available.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Increasing the duration of Deep Wounds to ensure that Junker Queen can maintain wounds even longer on enemies she’s actively targeting.

changes.text_en: Extended wound duration increased from 0.25 to 0.5 seconds.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: An additional element has been added to Prolonged Barrier to enable Ramattra to control a larger area and provide effective cover with the shield.
Developer Comments: We’re making improvements to several of Reinhardt's perks to increase their usability in various situations.
Developer Comments: The increased throw distance modifies how Roadhog can use Hog Toss. Adding a damage increase component will make Pig Pen more effective even when not utilizing the throw distance
Developer Comments: Short Circuit is being adjusted to improve its effectiveness in specific matchups against deployables such as barriers or turrets.

changes.text_en: Damage versus deployable objects increased from 30% to 50%

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: The transfer cost is being reduced to amplify the value of shields when given to allies.

changes.text_en: Ally transfer cost reduction increased from 33% to 50%.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Adding a resource meter will control Bastion's healing ability, ensuring more balanced gameplay and fair engagements with low damage output heroes.

changes.text_en: Now has a resource required to heal.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Increasing Past Noon's refund aims to improve High Noon and its zoning capabilities, adding incentive to change how the ultimate is used.

changes.text_en: Ultimate charge refunded increased from 30% to 40%.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: The utility of Genji’s perks, such as Acrobatics and Blade Twisting, has been limited due to their specific use cases. We have improved the conditions of these perks and increased the healing of Meditation to align it with other Major perks.

changes.text_en: Now also resets double jump on wall climb.
Healing increased from 25 to 35 health per second.
Duration after an elimination to trigger bonus damage increased from 6 to 10 seconds.
changes.raw_metric: duration after an elimination to trigger bonus damage

changes.text_en: Bonus damage is now dealt over 1 second instead of 2 seconds.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: The cooldown increase for Permafrost has been removed to ensure it does not create negative impact for Ice Wall.

changes.text_en: No longer increases cooldown of Ice Wall.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: We are increasing the amount of converted shields to enhance Pharah’s self-sufficiency when Helix Shields is selected.

changes.text_en: Converted Shields increased from 75 to 125.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: The recovery time change will allow Reaper to weave primary fire shots between uses of Dire Trigger, reducing the friction of using this ability.

changes.text_en: Recovery time reduced from 0.9 to 0.7 seconds.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Reducing Stim Pack's cast time will make it more responsive, allowing use during combat without dramatically affecting shooting uptime.

changes.text_en: Cast time reduced from 0.4 to 0.15 seconds.
Stim Pack anti-heal is now cleansable.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Improving Sombra's Major Perks to ensure they're providing value without heavily impacting her core gameplay.

changes.text_en: Range penalty reduced from 30% to 15%.
Hack is now uninterruptible from damage when healing allies.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Torbjörn’s Turret has become difficult to deal with when paired with his Major Perks. The base statistics of Deploy Turret are being reduced, and some power is being reallocated to the Minor Perk Craftsman.

changes.text_en: Base health reduced from 250 to 225.
Turret Damage reduced from 13 to 12.
Now additionally increases Deploy Turret base health by 25

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Increasing duration gives players additional time to take advantage of the overhealth after recalling.

changes.text_en: Overhealth duration increased from 3.5 to 6 seconds.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Increasing Assault Burst's attack speed to balance its loss of instant healing. Also, boosted Automated Healing as its current effectiveness is low for an ultimate perk.

changes.text_en: Healing per shot is increased from 25 to 30.
Attack speed increased from 20% to 30%.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Barrier Restoration now grants increased movement speed, offering Brigitte additional options when she is unable to use Shield Bash on opponents.

changes.text_en: After Shield Bashing, Brigitte gains 30% movement speed for 1.5 seconds.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Increasing the power of Summer Solstice for more effective use of her ultimate ability and improved flight time.

changes.text_en: Weapon recharging is no longer paused while using Quick Melee.
Additionally provides 30% increased attack speed while Captive Sun is active

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Enhancing Re-Boots to be a more valuable mobility perk, allowing players to hover for longer and utilize the double jump reset.

changes.text_en: Now also increases the duration of Glide Boost by 25%.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Triggering Superbloom can be challenging, so we are making several changes to improve the consistency of the perk.

changes.text_en: Damage increased from 30 to 40.
Number of hits to trigger increased from 16 to 20.
Window of time to land hits increased from 1.5 to 2.5 seconds.
changes.metric: window of time to land hits
changes.raw_metric: window of time to land hits

changes.text_en: Bonus to Healing Blossom heal increased from 20 to 30.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: The cast time has been shortened to make Flash Heal more responsive for use in emergency situations.

changes.text_en: Cast time reduced from 0.875 to 0.4 seconds.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body: Fixed an issue causing Maximilien’s Vault cards to not show a full 5 cards. Fixed an issue where the Overwatch League shop was missing from the shop menu. Fixed an issue causing disconnects with the replay system. Fixed an issue where the loot box thumbnails might not appear. Fixed an issue with the switch spawn button not working. Fixed a bug where some skins were incorrectly showing they were available for purchase in the hero gallery.

blocks.title: Heroes
blocks.body: Ana Fixed a bug where Ana's Bastet skin was missing from the game. Orisa In a previous update, fixed an issue where Orisa's overhealth would not restore if fully depleted using the Bulwark perk.
